rows.source_title: NY Department of Taxation and Finance: Tax facts, Property tax
rows.label: State oversight
rows.value: NY Department of Taxation and Finance, Office of Real Property Tax Services (ORPTS)

rows.section: New York property tax: state rules
rows.note: Applies to local governments and school districts outside the Big Five cities; can be overridden by a 60% vote. Guidance published 2011 (cap later made permanent).
rows.source_title: NY Department of Taxation and Finance and Department of State: Publication 1000, The Property Tax Cap, Guidelines for Implementation (10/11)
rows.label: Property tax levy cap
rows.value: Annual levy growth limited to 2% or the rate of inflation, whichever is less

rows.section: New York real estate transfer tax
rows.note: Equivalent to 0.4%. Paid by the seller; if the seller does not pay or is exempt, the buyer must pay.
rows.source_title: NY Department of Taxation and Finance: Real estate transfer tax (updated June 1, 2026)
rows.label: State real estate transfer tax
rows.value: $2 per $500 of consideration (or fraction), when consideration exceeds $500

rows.section: New York real estate transfer tax
rows.note: Additional 1% of the sale price on residences sold for $1 million or more; paid by the buyer.
rows.source_title: NY Department of Taxation and Finance: Real estate transfer tax (updated June 1, 2026)
rows.label: Mansion tax (residences of $1 million or more)

rows.section: New York real estate transfer tax
rows.note: State taxes on NYC conveyances since July 1, 2019; supplemental tax rates are in Form TP-584-NYC-I. Separate from the City's own transfer tax.
rows.source_title: NY Department of Taxation and Finance: Real estate transfer tax (updated June 1, 2026)
rows.label: New York City additional state taxes
rows.value: Additional base tax $1.25 per $500 (residential $3M+, other property $2M+); supplemental tax 0.25% to 2.9% on residential $2M+

rows.section: New York real estate transfer tax
rows.note: If the responsible party does not pay or is exempt, the other party must pay.
rows.source_title: NY Department of Taxation and Finance: Real estate transfer tax (updated June 1, 2026)
rows.label: Who pays
rows.value: Seller pays the base and additional base tax; buyer pays the mansion tax and supplemental tax

rows.section: New York sales and use tax
rows.note: State sales and use tax rate.
rows.source_title: Sales and use tax rates
rows.label: State sales tax rate

rows.section: New York sales and use tax
rows.note: The combined rate varies by county and by city.
rows.source_title: Sales and use tax rates
rows.label: Local sales taxes
rows.value: Counties, cities and school districts impose local sales taxes on top of the 4% state rate

rows.section: New York sales and use tax
rows.note: Metropolitan Commuter Transportation District (MCTD) additional rate on taxable sales within the district.
rows.source_title: Sales and use tax rates
rows.label: Special-district sales tax rate

rows.section: New York sales and use tax
rows.note: Food and food products sold by food stores are generally exempt; heated or ready-to-eat food, sandwiches, candy, soft drinks and similar items are taxable.
rows.source_title: Tax Bulletin ST-283: Food and Food Products Sold by Food Stores and Similar Establishments
rows.label: Groceries (food for home consumption)

rows.section: New York sales and use tax
rows.note: Prescription and nonprescription drugs and medicines for human use are exempt.
rows.source_title: Tax Bulletin: Drugstores and Pharmacies
rows.label: Prescription drugs

rows.section: New York sales and use tax
rows.note: Clothing and footwear under $110 per item or pair is exempt from the 4% state tax; local taxes apply unless the county or city elects the exemption (and the MCTD tax only where elected).
rows.source_title: Tax Bulletin ST-153: Exemption from Sales and Use Taxes on Clothing and Footwear
rows.label: Clothing (price per item less than $110)

rows.section: New York sales and use tax
rows.note: Taxable purchases on which no sales tax was paid (storage, use or consumption in the state). The state rate is the sales and use tax rate; local use taxes apply on top.
rows.source_title: Sales and use tax rates
rows.label: Use tax rate

rows.section: New York sales and use tax
rows.note: Sales of tangible personal property delivered into New York in the immediately preceding four sales tax quarters: must register above this amount AND more than 100 sales. Both tests must be met.
rows.source_title: Registration requirement for businesses with no physical presence in New York State
rows.label: Remote sellers: sales threshold

rows.section: New York sales and use tax
rows.note: Sales of tangible personal property delivered into New York in the immediately preceding four sales tax quarters: more than this number (together with more than $500,000). Counted in transactions. Both tests must be met.
rows.source_title: Registration requirement for businesses with no physical presence in New York State
rows.label: Remote sellers: transactions threshold

rows.section: New York estate and inheritance taxes
rows.note: Basic exclusion amount for dates of death in 2026. Rates come from the tax table on Form ET-706 for the date of death.
rows.source_title: Estate tax
rows.label: Estate tax: exemption

rows.section: New York excise taxes on cigarettes and motor fuel
rows.note: State cigarette excise tax. New York City adds a local excise tax of $1.50 per pack.
rows.source_title: Cigarette and tobacco products tax
rows.label: Cigarette tax (per pack of 20 cigarettes)

rows.section: New York excise taxes on cigarettes and motor fuel
rows.note: Motor fuel excise tax. The petroleum business tax adds 15.8 cents per gallon in 2026 (16.5 cents in 2025), and a 0.05-cent testing fee applies; sales tax also applies.
rows.source_title: Publication 908, Fuel Tax Rates
rows.label: Motor fuel tax (per gallon of motor fuel (gasoline))

rows.section: New York excise taxes on cigarettes and motor fuel
rows.note: Highway diesel motor fuel excise tax. The petroleum business tax adds 14.05 cents per gallon in 2026 (14.75 cents in 2025).
rows.source_title: Publication 908, Fuel Tax Rates
rows.label: Motor fuel tax (per gallon of highway diesel motor fuel)
